instruction: You are given a script template `/home/user/Desktop/model_compare.py`. In FLORIS 4.6.4, `jensen`, `gauss`, and `cc` are supported wake velocity-model strings; GCH is a configuration assembled from the Gauss velocity model and additional wake features, not a `velocity_model` string. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Write `/home/user/Desktop/compare.py`. Starting from a fresh copy of the FLORIS 4.6.4 default configuration for every run, use two `nrel_5MW` turbines at `layout_x=[0,630]`, `layout_y=[0,0]`, with wind direction `270 deg`, wind speed `8 m/s`, and turbulence intensity `0.06`. Set only `wake.model_strings.velocity_model` to `jensen`, `gauss`, and `cc`, respectively; call `run()` and extract turbine 1 power in kW for each case. 2. Execute the script and write `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as `jensen_t1_kw, gauss_t1_kw, cc_t1_kw`. 3. Do not use a GUI. [Software] Use Python with `floris==4.6.4` (for example, `from floris import FlorisModel`). On this machine, FLORIS is provided as the Python `floris` package at `/home/user/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/floris`; run the workflow from Python rather than looking for a separate desktop program.
